homelabDetails.description: A production-grade personal cloud for development, automation, media, gaming, and smart-home services. A dedicated Debian Docker host runs alongside a three-node Proxmox VE cluster, TrueNAS Core storage, and Raspberry Pi utility nodes — all behind OPNsense and a UniFi network. Cloudflare Zero Trust publishes selected services securely without opening inbound firewall ports.
specs: **Docker Host:** ThinkCentre M910q — i5-6500T, 16 GB RAM, 500 GB SSD, running Debian 12
**Proxmox Cluster:** Three Proxmox VE 9.2.2 nodes — one M910q and two M710q systems
**Cluster Capacity:** 64 GB total RAM with dedicated NVMe storage on pve2 and pve4
**Storage:** TrueNAS Core on an Intel N6005 with 16 GB RAM, six SATA bays, RAID-backed storage, and ~11 TB NFS backups
**Edge Nodes:** Four Raspberry Pi 4 units plus a Raspberry Pi 5 for utility and controller workloads
**Networking:** RiftRaven OPNsense firewall, 2.5G UniFi core, PoE switching, and Wi-Fi 7
**Secure Access:** Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnels with no direct inbound firewall exposure
**Services:** 15+ self-hosted workloads including Home Assistant, Frigate, n8n, Plex, MinIO, and Minecraft
**Development:** Mac Mini M4 and GMKTEC K8 Plus for primary development and AI workloads
